brief.t: Nine A M today, your Kristina intro call for Petit Nuage on Google Meet. Evelyn and Ron are on the invite. Prep before nine, then move to the revenue lane.

Elmar Nasibov pricing. Ronald re-sent the full costing yesterday and Aidan confirmed. I need one thing from you — the margin, seventy five or sixty five — and I build and send the quote within the hour. He has asked three plus times.

Victor Armendarez. Overdue since Friday, eighty seven percent close. Curl Cream and Edge Gel, two thousand units each. Still blocked on Ronald's raw cost per unit. One number and I quote at seventy five percent margin today.
EPHIX and Regis Salons. Jon Alt from Regis Corp emailed Aidan and forwarded it to you. Regis is a national salon company, potentially large. Read it and tell me the play.
James Bailey, Morning Glory. He replied to Laura and wants a couple small additions to the scope before he signs. Loop Laura, update the scope, get the signature. He is ready to close.
Good news. Drake True Revival paid the twenty eight hundred dollar R and D fee. The deal is moving. Just say go and I email the corrected agreement to Laura.
The CRM REST API is live but the key they gave me is dead. I verified the setup and flagged the bad key in the thread. Once I have a working key I run the CRM directly, no more browser breakage.

kb.a: Nine A M Tuesday July fourteenth, Kristina intro call for Petit Nuage on Google Meet, nine to ten Eastern. Evelyn and Ron are on the invite. Prep the intro before nine.

Elmar Nasibov wants pricing for Hydrating Mist 100mL, Peptide Cream 50mL, and Hydrating Serum 30mL, fifteen hundred units total. Ronald re-sent the full formulations and costing on July thirteenth and Aidan confirmed. Now blocked only on your margin call — seventy five or sixty five. Give me that and I build and send today. He has asked three plus times.

Victor Armendarez needs pricing for Curl Defining Cream and Edge Gel in six ounce jars, two thousand units each. Eighty seven percent close, seventy five percent margin, NDA signed. Overdue since Friday July tenth. Blocked only on Ronald's raw cost per unit for the two SKUs.

EPHIX and Regis Salons. Jon Alt from Regis Corp emailed Aidan on July thirteenth and Aidan forwarded it to Sam. Regis is a national salon company, potentially a large opportunity. Needs Sam to read and decide the reply.

James Bailey of Morning Glory replied to Laura on the revised scope and estimate. He wants a couple small additions before signing. Loop Laura, update the scope, get the signature. He is ready to close.
Maria Robles of Robles BioCeutics is a new inbound lead from the site contact form on July thirteenth. Sam already replied asking private label versus custom. Awaiting her answer, keep warm.
Afaf Awadh, AF Brand, replied to Nikkie. Still interested, evaluating samples before deciding. Meeting is on the calendar for Wednesday.
Francesco Gatti booked a thirty minute call for Thursday July sixteenth at three P M Eastern via Calendly.

Drake Militello, True Revival, paid the twenty eight hundred dollar R and D fee on July thirteenth, order fourteen forty four. The corrected final agreement is uploaded to his CRM profile. Just needs Sam's go to email the corrected version to Laura.

The CRM developer shipped REST API version one, commit d six two eight two two a, and it is live. But the API key provisioned for the agent is dead — returns invalid or revoked. The agent verified the infrastructure works, flagged the bad key in the same thread, and is waiting on a working key. Once fixed, the agent runs the CRM directly instead of browser automation.
Sam started connecting Microsoft Clarity to the Shopify store. He needs to approve the project invite in his inbox, then behavior analytics start compounding. Free.

The Organic Agent finished its day one job. The roughly fifty four percent organic lead drop is caused by branded search collapsing — people googling private label labs and not clicking. Impressions were flat and ranking even improved, so it is a click problem not a ranking problem. Day two needs Sam's OK to inspect the live Google results for the brand name and find what is stealing the click.

Nadia Dupuis, Oreka Skincare. Quote Q double oh oh seven accepted. Pending: log the eighty five fifty five dollar payment, open a production job for one thousand units Peptide Cream, and delete the orphan formula on Q double oh oh six. Awaiting Sam's confirm.
ASSEA with Apostolia. Ronald answered the refrigeration and shipping precautions. Still need to relay that to Apostolia via WhatsApp. NDA and HS-code docs still outstanding.
Aran Beauty wants Vanilla, Jasmine, Rose, and Sweet Orange scent samples. Ronald was nudged July ninth and has not replied.
Terra Lotus. Kenna added thirty thousand units face cleanser plus a sample request. Aidan's CRM task still does not include the thirty K cleanser. Awaiting Sam's confirm to update it.

Pure Good. Quote Q double oh two eight at three hundred twenty nine thousand dollars is blocked because Kenna gatekeeps all communication. Aidan's pricing task for Cleanser ten K and Hair Mask ten K is overdue.

Ben Kar from Tavro wants custom tallow plus argan oil, thirty thousand units, ninety percent close. One Google Meet and one unanswered WhatsApp, no proposal ever sent. Agent is drafting the proposal for Sam's review.
Sky and Sol, roughly thirty thousand dollar deal. Sample sent, client back July eleventh. Sam's follow-up is overdue.
Aidan Kraim has multiple overdue tasks including the Kenna Atlas quote, Pure Good and Terra Lotus pricing. He did re-engage on Elmar and forwarded the Regis Salons email to Sam.
Ronald the chemist re-sent the Elmar costing and answered ASSEA refrigeration. Still open: Aran Beauty scent samples and the Maqui Berry revision.

Standard margin is sixty five percent. Sam specified seventy five percent for Victor. Still need to confirm whether seventy five is the new standard or Victor only. Fill, labor, and overhead rates are still not in the CRM.
Dashboard shows about one million three hundred sixty five thousand dollars pipeline across ten active deals. Sixty eight customers, roughly two hundred twenty open tasks.
Command Lab is on version five point one with the Agent Comms panel live. Six acceptance tests passed. The webhook to feed relay for at-mention routing is still being finalized.

The Growth Engine has three agents — Organic, Email, and Ads — with Sam's main agent as ROI overseer routing through a shared scoreboard. Organic is launched. Email is next as the attribution keystone. Ads is last. ConvertFlow popup form fills will be tracked as a third lead lane via webhook.
The new facility lease is closed and the move is underway with GC, contractors, and GMP certification running together. The move checklist is not yet drafted, deferred until current fires clear.
